title: Otori Emu — Helping You Show Thanks〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: White Day
Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
Our White Day party was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm really glad that Miku and the others liked the cards I made for them☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (I hope my remaining cards are received the same way.)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (Mom and Dad won't be home until late, but Sis and the others should be home by dinner...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, I'll give them their cards then!
Now I really can't wait for dinner☆
Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Dinnertime♪ Dinnertime♪ I wonder what we're having tonight!
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. You seem to be in a good mood, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Sis!
I have something for you!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, for me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! Here you are☆
I made this card just for you!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Wow, this is so adorable...!
The whole card looks just like a flower field.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I really love how you always have a cheerful smile on your face!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So I decided to use plenty of pretty stickers and masking tape to make a flower field that's just as happy and smiley as you!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Thank you, Emu.
I don't know what to say.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You gave me those cute chocolates for Valentine's Day, and now you're giving me this beautiful card for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The thing is, I got to help out with a White Day event where everyone made their own thank you cards.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I got to watch a bunch of people pour their feelings into their very own, one-of-a-kind cards.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I decided to make a card for you, Sis. Packed full of all my gratitude and love!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: You're always such a ray of sunshine for me, Emu. I hope you know I'm always here for you if you need me.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Still, you beat me to the punch.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
I also prepared a White Day gift for you.
I'll give it to you after dinner, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really...? Thanks, Sis!
I can't wait to see what it is!
se_walk_men_005_1
se_walk_men_005_2

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It's finally time for dinner. I'm famished after all those meetings...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you guys are back!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Hm? Were you looking for us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Guess what?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Here you are, Shosuke, Keisuke!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want to thank you for helping me and the others pursue our dreams, Shosuke.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I want to thank you for always giving me such great advice, Keisuke!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Wait, these cards...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Are these White Day gifts?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: They're pretty elaborate. They each have a completely different design to them... Did you make these yourself?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I drew lots of pictures that I knew would make you guys smile from ear to ear☆

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Oh, that explains why there's the Phoenix Coaster and some corn dogs on mine.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I see. Mine has a Ferris wheel and some deep-fried mackerels.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Wait, fried mackerels...?
I guess you do like them a lot, but still.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Still, these are a fine expression of your feelings, and wonderful presents to receive. Thank you, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Yeah, true. Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I can't wait to give Mom and Dad their cards☆

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Oh, they won't make it in time for dinner, but they did say that they'll try to come home as quickly as they can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really?! Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Anyway, why don't we start eating?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Shosuke and I asked the chef to prepare some special dishes as a way to thank you both for the Valentine's Day gifts that you gave us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?! Special dishes?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I wonder what he made? I'm excited already!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks, you guys!
